meta_description: Sandstone facade cladding tiles for house exteriors: a sand-toned stone face for front elevations, entrances and feature panels. Free WhatsApp sample.
description:
These sandstone facade cladding tiles give a house exterior a natural, sand-toned stone face; Pak Clay supplies them for front elevations, entrances, boundary walls and feature panels.

## How they look
The stone face is textured and warm in tone, so a facade picks up light and shadow across the day. Natural stone varies from piece to piece, which gives a large elevation depth instead of the flat look of paint or plaster. It pairs well with dark window frames, wood doors and green planting.

## Where they work
- **Front elevations** of houses and farmhouses, as exterior wall cladding over the whole face or a section.
- **Entrances, porches and gate pillars**.
- **Feature panels** on boundary walls or around balconies.

A stone facade for a house tends to hold up well outdoors and needs little more than occasional washing. Cladding is fixed to the wall face rather than used as flooring, so tell us the wall type when you ask.

## Good to know
- Material: natural sandstone
- Use: exterior wall cladding and facades
- Category: outdoor stone wall tiles
- Size, thickness and coverage per square foot: confirm on enquiry

Stone is heavier than clay or ceramic, so fix it with a suitable exterior adhesive on a sound, clean wall, and ask your contractor whether mechanical fixing is needed for high walls. See [house front wall tiles design ideas](/blog/house-front-wall-tiles-design-ideas-stone-and-brick-elevation) for elevation layouts.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the tone and texture in daylight, then send your wall area and city for a dated quote. For boundary walls and smaller panels, compare the [exterior natural sandstone wall tiles](/products/exterior-natural-sand-stone-wall-tiles), or browse all [outdoor stone wall tiles](/categories/outdoor-wall-tiles-stone).

faqs.q: What is the price of sandstone facade cladding tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the wall area, thickness, fixing, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Is sandstone cladding suitable for a house front in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Sandstone is widely used on house elevations because it tends to weather well outdoors. It is heavy, so the wall must be sound and the fixing method suited to the height; ask your contractor to confirm.

faqs.q: Sandstone cladding or brick gutka: which looks better on a front wall?
faqs.a: Sandstone gives a warm, textured stone look; red gutka gives a traditional exposed-brick look. Many elevations mix the two. Compare samples against your paint and window colours.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Sand Stone Facade Cladding" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
